# smol-toml (vendored)

- Upstream: <https://github.com/squirrelchat/smol-toml>, npm `smol-toml@1.9.0`, integrity
  `sha512-hpd+HLON7HdZXqYchMM/+LaTTbdK0AU3NngIJ4KVyWbY9bfQqdL9cD+4yf6dUoU2Ap4VsU0JkQi6FxAI1B2mXQ==`.
- Licence: BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) Squirrel Chat et al.; see `LICENSE`. `smol-toml.mjs` keeps
  the upstream licence header at its top.
- `smol-toml.mjs` is generated by `tools/vendor-smol-toml.ts` from the tarball's
  `dist/{error,date,util,primitive,struct,extract,parse}.js`: the modules joined in dependency
  order, relative imports removed, the identical licence header kept once. Code is otherwise
  unchanged. The last line, `// Ignore license in this file: …`, is Surfer's marker that lets
  `surfer license-check` (which wants MPL headers in `src/`) accept a file under another licence.
  One file, because that marker check is only reliable for a single such file per run.
- `smol-toml.d.mts` is vimma's, not upstream's.
- Why this parser: `docs/specs/m5-core-config-and-theme.md` § Settled. To update: `npm pack
smol-toml@<version>`, unpack, `node tools/vendor-smol-toml.ts package`, run `npm test`. Do not
  edit `smol-toml.mjs` by hand.
